'''''No Division''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a stylized close-up of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with the phrase "No Division" written across the bottom in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], a [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] used to represent the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. The helmet was bisected vertically with the standard [[Color/Legends|black]] and white coloring of it reversed on the left side. While the text was white on the left side, it became black at that line of symmetry.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''No Division'' was a poster that appeared in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massive multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released for the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] in [[2003]], where it could be used in the player character's home as decoration. The poster was originally available as loot from the corpses of stormtrooper enemies in the game, but it was removed with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|Combat Upgrade]]" in [[2005]]. The poster was reintroduced to the game as part of the "rare loot system" in the ''Hotfix 17.10'' game update on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The system allowed players to receive increasingly rare items as loot from any defeated enemy in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
